column1: # The sun-sanity pass's open findings (tools/timetables sunSanity; SunSanity.kt): starts the engine shows before the
# real sun allows, at app cities, unit points or Settings choices at app cities, on 2026-11-12..2027-12-31, which
# nothing in the day excuses. Each is a fitted margin below zero that keeps the start at its authority's printed
# minute (the gate holds every one never early and within its limit), so the authority's own minute sits at or before
# the true transit or sunset there. Listed so the pass fails only on a new one or a listed one that grows; a fix is the
# owner's call (the never-early standard is the local table's). The note gives the smallest margin raise that clears
# the pass, found by re-running it with the margin raised one second at a time, and what the gate says after it (whole
# gate rows of the entry, same archive).
# Ceilings: worst_s is the worst seconds before the sun found, rounded up to the next whole second, plus one second for
# the default window's drift from year to year; points is the number of points found. The pass fails when a finding is
# worse than worst_s or found at more points (a margin that slips, a rule that spreads to new towns): re-measure, and
# raise a ceiling only with the reason in the note.
# Run of 12 Nov 2026 on engine/ramadan-guard (46,085 points, 5,258 of them Settings choices); place-days count both Asr
